front:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: clean single-view character reference for image-to-3D Tripo generation and rigging into Trigger Run.
Input image: identity, costume and palette REFERENCE, not an edit target. Translate this exact red/white-haired male Nezha into a coherent complete game character.
Primary request: ONE single full-body straight FRONT orthographic view, neutral symmetrical anatomically correct T-POSE: two arms fully extended horizontally at shoulder height, elbows straight, hands open with all five fingers readable, palms downward, legs straight slightly apart, feet forward. Adult masculine athletic warrior, about seven and a half heads tall. Head upright facing viewer. Entire body from spiky hair to boot soles and fingertip to fingertip visible with comfortable margins.
Preserve recognizable handsome masculine face, short voluminous swept spiky white hair with a crimson-red section on character's RIGHT (viewer left); red geometric mystical markings on forehead, cheeks and neck; amber orange eyes with visibly distinct pupils, red scarf around neck; polished blackened metal armor with restrained aged bronze gold edging and sculpted compact dragon-headed shoulder pauldrons, orange-red inset fiery jewel centered on chest and another at belt. Keep shoulder dragon shapes below ear level, close to upper arms, with clear space at neck and arm joints. Charcoal flexible underlayer at armpits/elbows. Bronze black fitted bracers, articulated gloves with distinct fingers. Add coherent lower body: dark fitted trousers, separate short thigh plates with small red hanging cloth panels ending above knees and bronze accents, articulated knee armor and practical armored black/bronze boots. Scarf has ONE narrow short red fabric tail behind upper back ending at waist, no broad cape. Simplify chains into few substantial ornaments. Fine surface details clear but armor not covered by smoke or flames.
Style: high-quality stylized realistic 3D game character product render, sharply legible sculpted forms and texture, neutral diffuse studio lighting, minimal ambient occlusion, neither flat illustration nor cinematic lighting. Materials separate: metal black/bronze, woven red cloth, skin.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. No ground plane, no shadow outside figure, no text, labels, logos, weapons, extra arms, other characters, duplicated views, particles, floating ornaments, scenery. Only one figure.

views.name: 02-esquerda
views.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE orthographic character view for Tripo multi-view image-to-3D.
REFERENCE image is the authoritative full-body FRONT view of the same Nezha skin. Rotate this exact same character for the requested view, preserve facial identity, white hair with crimson section on CHARACTER RIGHT, compact bronze black dragon shoulders, armor thickness/contours, orange gems, red scarves, dark trousers, red thigh panels, bronze black boots, material textures, finger/glove anatomy. Exactly same height and proportions. High-quality 3D game character reference, diffuse neutral lighting, sharp detail. FULL BODY visible with margins, hair to boot soles and extended fingertips. Neutral upright T-pose with both arms straight and horizontal at shoulder height, elbows straight, hands open palms down; feet separated slightly. ONLY TWO arms. No weapons.
One narrow red scarf tail falls from back of neck to waist, no huge cloak or armor spikes behind back. Back armor coherent fitted black/bronze segmented plates and small central inset ember detail, articulated waist. No newly invented props.
Genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, no environment, ground, cast shadow, text, labels, logos, grid, multiple views, extra characters, smoke or flame particles.
Requested camera: TRUE LEFT PROFILE VIEW showing character's LEFT side. Face points toward the LEFT EDGE of the image. Camera orthographic directly from character LEFT, not three-quarter. Two T-pose arms overlap in profile and project toward/away camera; do NOT swing arms forward or lower them simply to show hands. Face nose points left, left ear visible. Feet point left.
